## What lives here
The backend application package: the routes, services, pipelines (core plus layers), the domain packages (auth, vault, rules, catalog, knowledge, rag, process, runs, remote_servers and others) and the configuration.

## Conventions
One package per domain. Each has `models.py` (SQLAlchemy tables, added through `create_all` plus additive `schema.py` migrations), `store.py` (CRUD) and logic modules. Routes stay thin over services. Workspace scoping is applied by `auth/scoping` for registered models. Long work runs as background runs (`runs/`) or reports progress through `progress/`.

## Entry points
`main.py` (the FastAPI app, middleware and startup), `config.py` (settings), `database.py` / `db_setup.py` (tables and seeds) and `routes/` (HTTP).
